title: Fifty moves for Arata
gives: Fifty working documents from the Brew deployment team, one per marketing discipline, every one built on Arata's real catalogue, prices, claims, customers and competitors. Read this index, then open the move you want to see.
howTo: The six groups follow a customer from first search to third bottle. Each document ends with a 30-day deployment table and the metric we are held to.
subtitle: Every marketing discipline, run for one brand, end to end, by one team.
live: The first ten moves are live: positioning, pricing ladder, offers, measurement, and the MitoActive proof relaunch are in market.

      10 moves            9 moves            9 moves              10 moves              6 moves                6 moves

 One number runs through all 50: 84 days. Every claim on an Arata bottle resolves inside that window. So does every move here.

Arata today: ₹61 Cr FY25, 192% growth, 1.5M customers a year, 68% of revenue on marketplaces and quick commerce, a ₹1,499 hero serum with zero reviews, no subscription, no routine builder, and a ₹160 Cr goal. That is a brand with proof and no system. The fifty moves below are the system.
